regime_context: China A-shares detector reads as a narrow, one-narrative tape: only 2 of 22 themes are trend-eligible, cleanliness is thin (absorption 0.34), and the absolute-trend gate did NOT cut drawdown in this market's history (gate_helps = false, mean-revert whipsaw). Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha; the only validated edge (drawdown control) is explicitly non-functional here, so this note leans low.

The watch retires if Gold Miners earns a theme-level ETF proxy with breadth above 0.3, or if Coal extends its lead back above 0.15.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only eligible theme with a live absolute-trend gate (score 0.992, durability_bar 0.52, breadth 0.5, not crowded). In a one-narrative, narrow-rotation tape, the gate's drawdown-control role is the only leg with any claimed edge — but that edge failed backtests on this exact market. This is a conditional lean on the gate holding, not a momentum call.
evidence: breadth 0.5 (cohesion present, not a single-name spike)
theses.dissent: backtest_verdict.absolute_trend_gate = 'did_NOT_hold_here' — the gate did not reduce drawdown on this mean-reverting tape, so the one leg supporting an overweight is exactly the leg that failed this market.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS breaks below its absolute-trend gate level before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is eligible with the strongest durability of any eligible theme (0.83) and full breadth (1.0), but crowding_z 1.83 (crowded = true) flags the one valid caution the detector permits: a SIZE-DOWN reflexivity risk, not a fade. In this market where the trend gate is unreliable, leaning into a crowded, fully-extended trend carries asymmetric downside.
theses.dissent: full breadth and high durability suggest genuine participation, not a fragile ledge; crowding cautions are coincident, not predictive, and avoiding a strong trend in a mean-revert tape may forfeit the only momentum present.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS holds its trend and breadth stays above 0.8 through the check-by date

theses.subject: Solar / Photovoltaics
theses.thesis: Solar ranks dead last (rank 20, score -0.532), has the weakest durability (0.18), near-zero breadth (0.067), and is ineligible. Crowding_z -2.27 (not crowded) removes one contrarian cushion. In a market where the trend gate whipsaws, the cleanest read is absence of leadership, not a reversion.
theses.dissent: mean-revert hurst_tag on the broader tape means deeply extended losers can snap back violently; an underweight loses if the gate whipsaws a broad recovery.

falsifier.text: 515790.SS closes up 8% from its current level before the check-by date
